svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));
fill: light-dark(rgb(175, 197, 238), rgb(52, 71, 107)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(175, 197, 238), rgb(52, 71, 107));
fill: light-dark(rgb(191, 216, 170), rgb(44, 66, 26)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(191, 216, 170), rgb(44, 66, 26));
fill: light-dark(rgb(253, 229, 162), rgb(60, 40, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(253, 229, 162), rgb(60, 40, 0));
fill: light-dark(rgb(78, 130, 229), rgb(87, 132, 217)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(78, 130, 229), rgb(87, 132, 217));

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(78, 130, 229), rgb(87, 132, 217)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(78, 130, 229), rgb(87, 132, 217));

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(143, 190, 105), rgb(62, 102, 29)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(143, 190, 105), rgb(62, 102, 29));

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(143, 190, 105), rgb(62, 102, 29)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(143, 190, 105), rgb(62, 102, 29));

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(246, 211, 91), rgb(88, 58, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(246, 211, 91), rgb(88, 58, 0));

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(246, 211, 91), rgb(88, 58, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(246, 211, 91), rgb(88, 58, 0));
